likely_questions: Which release and what is the priority?
Which failures need a new state?

missing_information.question: Which API failures should trigger the error state?
Does this include cart, address and payment?

improvement.revised_draft: Checkout feels slow. Before the release, simplify the flow and make error states clearer. Confirm [affected screens?], [failure conditions?] and [review and implementation dates?] before starting.
unresolved_information: Which failures need an error state?
When are review and implementation needed?

improvement.revised_draft: For payment errors, show an inline retry message. Cart and address are out of scope. Please prioritize the mockup for review on Friday; implementation timing is not agreed.

messages.text: For the release, let’s simplify all checkout screens.
I’m planning changes to the payment screen only. The API will stay the same.
My draft covers cart, address and payment. Are all three in scope?
Good question. Let’s settle the scope here before anyone starts building. Jamie, what would keep the implementation manageable?
Payment first would help. We can keep the existing API contract and handle the failed-payment state in the UI.
I’ll start with the payment states then. One open question: do we keep the form values after a failed attempt?

interpretations.understanding: All checkout screens may be included.
Cart, address and payment appear in the draft; scope is still a question.

disagreements.question: Which screens should change for this release?

messages.text: For this review, payment is the only screen in scope. Cart and address can wait.
Agreed: payment only. I’ll show inline retry messages for failed payments, with cart and address unchanged.

interpretations.understanding: Only payment is included in this review. Do not change the cart or address screens for this work.
Sam agrees to payment-only scope. Failed payments will get a retry message beside the relevant form; cart and address remain unchanged.

messages.text: A quick home for decisions and progress. Bring the discussion to #team-checkout; share the outcome here.
The updated component library is ready for review. Error, loading and empty states are included.
Thanks! I’ll use these states for the next checkout iteration.

interpretations.understanding: Use this channel to share decisions and progress. Discuss the details in team-checkout, then post the outcome here.
Jamie intends to use those prepared error, loading and empty states in the next checkout update.
Sam has prepared reusable interface components for review, including how the screen looks when something fails, is loading or has no content.

messages.text: Only the payment screen is in scope. Keep cart and address unchanged.
Agreed: payment only, with no changes to cart or address.
My mockups match: payment only. Cart and address stay unchanged.

interpretations.understanding: Only the payment screen should change. Cart and address are explicitly excluded.
Jamie agrees to change payment only and leave cart and address as they are.
Sam confirms the designs follow the same payment-only scope. Cart and address stay unchanged.
